chunks: Fāṭimah عليها السلام used to visit the graves of the martyrs every Saturday morning. Then she would come to the grave of Ḥamzah, invoke mercy for him, and seek forgiveness for him.

key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ: Fāṭimah عليها السلام, daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How did Fāṭimah عليها السلام visit the graves of the martyrs and what did she do at the grave of Ḥamzah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Fāṭimah عليها السلام regularly visited the graves of the martyrs, especially the grave of Ḥamzah. It highlights remembrance of the righteous dead, showing mercy toward them, and seeking forgiveness for them.
